indexes corpus

  • CURIE: gmeow:indexesCorpus
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/indexesCorpus
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/graphrag

The corpus whose embeddings this index serves. Non-functional: a federated index may span corpora.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:VectorIndex -> gmeow:Corpus

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:indexesCorpus from gmeow:VectorIndex to gmeow:Corpus when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
